build_dqn_agent: build a DQN agent with epsilon-greedy policy and replay buffer for reinforcement learning
create_valuenet_module: create a Sonnet value network module with MLP and linear output layer for Q-values
run_agent_step: run the agent step method to select an action using epsilon-greedy policy from a timestep
test_agent_update: test the agent update method by feeding environment transitions and triggering batch training
refactor_batched_index: refactor the batched index helper to select Q-values by action index using one-hot encoding
